data.body: **P2:** When a chained target completes while the parent handler is still running, completion records its operation ID, but `record_invocation_completion()` clears the entire `updated_operation_ids` collection before this deferred reinvocation starts. The next invocation therefore observes the terminal operation state but omits it from `UpdatedOperationIds`, so plugin/OTel operation-update hooks miss the completion. Snapshot and clear IDs when building an invocation, or clear only the IDs included in that invocation so concurrently added IDs survive for the follow-up.
